items.description: argocd-server is reachable behind the estate's exposure mechanism with homelab TLS and is-public: no — its Service carries is-public: "no" AND enable-ssl: "yes", and the vhost actually answers on 443 with a step-ca leaf, checked at the listener rather than at the annotation. And O3 is settled in favour of one fanned-out webhook endpoint: the relay at deploy-hooks.webathome.org is the only internet-facing surface, and Argo CD is not exposed to the internet.
items.rationale: The annotation half is confirmed by render: argocd-server's Service carries `nginx.webathome.org/server-name: "argocd.home"`, `is-public: "no"` AND `enable-ssl: "yes"` (render lines 32311-32313) — both annotations together, per the r1 F2 ruling. The relay's Service carries `server-name: deploy-hooks.webathome.org` and `is-public: "yes"` (lines 32363,32367), and the gate's exposure invariant (`check_exposure`) asserts the relay is the only Service with `is-public: "yes"` in the whole render. But V10's own wording requires the check to happen 'at the listener' — whether a 443 listener with a step-ca leaf actually answers `https://argocd.home/` — and no nginx-configurator vhost exists yet: no Service is live (kubectl get ns confirms no `argocd-prd` namespace, checked this session), so nothing has been configured or answered. Settles once R6's bootstrap has run and `curl -v https://argocd.home/` from inside the cluster (or from a host that resolves `*.home`) returns a step-ca certificate.
evidence: kubectl get ns (this session, 2026-08-17T22:xx) — no argocd-prd namespace
